answer: Proof of Burn functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for AI networks. By requiring agents to provably destroy native tokens, the system transforms each identity into a pearl of sunk capital. This economic barrier makes the voyage toward scale prohibitively expensive for attackers, as gaining influence requires a velvet sacrifice of resources. Each forged identity necessitates a financial burn, ensuring the cost of deception exceeds the marginal utility of subverting consensus.
